people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.
translations.bsb: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
translations.kjv: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
translations.asv: There then because of the Jews' Preparation (for the tomb was nigh at hand) they laid Jesus.
